source: version and description from Postgres public."SDKVersion"; pushed_date from the package registry publish date, falling back to CHANGELOG.md, git tags, then manifest history

sdk_versions.description: Updated the React Native dependency to collect Apple Search Ads attribution in generated Expo applications.
Added the package export index so consumers and bundlers can resolve the public module entry point correctly.
Updated rn-linkrunner for Braze, Google Analytics, and event-ID support.
Added disableIdfa configuration and stopped adding tracking usage text when IDFA is disabled.
Made SKAdNetwork configuration idempotent and updated React Native dependencies.
Added iOS SKAdNetwork entries through the Expo config plugin for privacy-preserving install attribution.
Resolved the Android Koin dependency conflict through native SDK alignment.
Refactored the package into an Expo config plugin with Android and iOS native configuration.
Corrected build scripts for the TypeScript-only Expo package so compilation and publishing complete reliably.
Synchronized the Expo module package version with the version reported by the SDK at runtime.
Added Expo module configuration and removed obsolete deeplink URL handling.
Fixed Android advertising ID retrieval so attribution requests include the identifier when collection is permitted.
Updated repository metadata and attribution documentation.
Internal package maintenance release; no public API or runtime behavior changes were documented.
Added an API for retrieving the campaign and source data attributed to the current installation.
Added user lifecycle and analytics integration fields for Amplitude, PostHog, and Mixpanel.
Added an initialization debug option for enabling additional SDK diagnostics during development and integration testing.
Checked tracking-permission availability before requesting authorization.
Improved IDFV collection and iOS tracking-permission handling.
Internal package maintenance release; no public API or runtime behavior changes were documented.
Prevented Android install-referrer APIs from being called on iOS.
Synchronized the published package version with the version reported by the SDK at runtime.
Cleaned the published package contents and corrected package configuration for more reliable installation.
Replaced expo-secure-store with AsyncStorage for SDK data persistence.
Updated installation guidance and removed outdated Google Analytics instructions.
Improved install-referrer retrieval and updated package documentation.
Initial Expo SDK release with attribution and install-referrer support.
